title: Mythrift's Modpack
description: A modpack for Mythrift, a 1.21.1 Minecraft MMORPG survival server by KY25NGIE
body: Do you want a lightweight modpack that has everything you need like classes, magic, dragons, furniture, and a beautiful world that fits into the vanilla style of Minecraft? Look no further, because we got you covered! Mythrift's Modpack is a 1.21.1 MMORPG-like survival modpack compiled by KY25NGIE & Kqiserr! Now, enjoy.
